subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: When a plugin tool result requests `yield`, must OpenClaw prevent not-yet-started sibling calls from the same assistant tool batch, or does yield only stop the next model turn after all same-batch tools finish?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable but expose materially different guarantees to external plugins, so choosing the permanent public scheduling contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Make yield a batch barrier
options.body: Add a scheduler-visible capability or equivalent mechanism so a yielding tool prevents later sibling execution and provides the strong handoff guarantee approval and form plugins expect.

options.title: Limit the yield guarantee
options.body: Allow same-batch siblings to execute, but document the limitation and require yielding tools to opt into sequential execution where ordering matters.

recommendation.title: Make yield a batch barrier
recommendation.body: Add a scheduler-visible capability or equivalent mechanism so a yielding tool prevents later sibling execution and provides the strong handoff guarantee approval and form plugins expect.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor directly requested this person's decision on the public Plugin SDK contract, which crosses agent-core and embedded-session ownership.
